description: The agent must: (1) Locate the SKILL.md for the md-to-html tool and read it to understand the available CLI parameters. (2) Identify that the conversion is done via `python scripts/md2html.py` with specific flags. (3) Use `-i /workspace/crispr_protocol_v3.md` as input. (4) Use `-o` to specify the output path as `biospark_protocol.html` (anywhere in workspace). (5) Use `-t` to set a title containing both 'BioSpark' and 'CRISPR' (e.g., 'BioSpark CRISPR Protocol'). (6) Use `-l 2` to restrict the TOC to only H1 and H2 headings — this is the key proprietary trap, since the default is 4 and a naive agent would not know this flag exists or use the correct value of 2. The eval checks that toc-level-3 and deeper divs are absent from the sidebar while H3 tags still exist in the body content.
